newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen explains Biogen cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cowen explains Biogen cut.

text.p: -- Cowen & Co analyst David Stone said in a research note Friday he reduced the rating on Biogen Inc to buy from strong buy due to slowing growth of its multiple sclerosis drug Avonex.

-- Stone said that, based on first quarter trends and guidance from management, he reduced the 1997 sales estimates to $265 million from $290 million, with the 1998 sales estimate remaining at $450 million.
-- Reduced the 12-month price target to $50 from $60.
